issues: Unresolved prohibited deletions can escape the continuation veto through an early repair exit. In execute_phase, outstanding_deletions raises MasterError, which is caught and followed by approve_phase_plan. If that call returns None, execute_phase returns before reaching its final outstanding_deletions check. Master.run can then schedule an independent eligible phase while preserved project files remain deleted. The protection interface covers frozen evidence and controls, not every editable file tracked by outstanding_deletions. Repair: enforce the outstanding-deletion invariant whenever a phase yields back to the scheduler, including failed/blocked replanning and other early returns. Preserve the deletion obligations and stop further phase execution until restoration; allow the current bounded repair path to attempt restoration first.
next_actions: Add a scheduler-boundary check that raises ContinuationVeto when the attempted phase retains outstanding_deletions, regardless of how execute_phase returned.

Add a regression covering a worker deletion followed by a replanning refusal or external block, with an independent phase eligible. Verify that the independent phase never launches and that deletion obligations survive resume.
Rerun the controller checks and obtain a fresh read-only review after the repair.
